intro.title: One good photo.
intro.body: Every hold you set lives on it, so it pays to get the shot right.

good.title: The shot that works
tips: Stand square on to the wall
Tilt it to match the wall's angle
good.result: Every hold the same size and shape

landscape.title: Not landscape
landscape.body: You climb with the phone upright. A landscape photo shrinks to a strip and the holds get too small to tap.

side.title: Not from the side
side.body: Off to one side, the far holds shrink and bunch up.

upright.title: Not straight up and down
upright.body: Hold the phone upright under an overhang and the top looms while the bottom shrinks away.

why.title: Why it matters
why.body: The hold finder reads your photo as it is. Skewed holds come out small and stretched, so more of them get missed.

name.title: Name it, set the angle
name.body: The angle is fixed once you publish.

photo.title: Choose your photo
photo.body: The one you shot square on, in portrait.

corners.title: Mark the corners
corners.body: Drag the four rings onto the corners of the wall.

add.title: Tap the wall to add a hold
add.body: A ring drops where you tap.

resize.title: Press and hold to fix a ring
resize.body: Make it bigger or smaller, trace it, or remove it.

draw.title: Missed one? Draw round it
draw.body: Tap +, then trace the hold with one finger.

look.title: Pick how your holds light up
look.body: Then publish, and the wall is on your boards.

publish.title: Your wall is set up
publish.body: Time to set the first climb.

open.title: Change holds any time
open.body: Tap your wall's name, then Edit holds.

remove.title: Hold came off? Remove it
remove.body: Press and hold its ring, then tap Remove.

add.title: New hold? Tap to add it
add.body: Draw round it if it's an odd shape.

publish.title: Publish holds
publish.body: Do it when you're done editing.
